userStories.title: Listen on the configured address
acceptanceCriteria: The server listens on 127.0.0.1:8080 unless PASTEBIN_ADDR is set, in which case it listens on that host:port.

userStories.title: Stop on SIGTERM
acceptanceCriteria: On SIGTERM the server stops accepting new connections at once.
In-flight requests are given at most 2 seconds to finish, and the process exits within 2 seconds of SIGTERM.
